messages:
elaine: quick follow-up on the postmortem: we still have ~4 open actions. need owners, jira links, and acceptance criteria.
omar: I can pick up the DB connection pool leak (TCK-8120). plan: reproduce, add metric, and patch. R: omar, A: taylor, C: lee. ETA Fri COB.
taylor: noted. will be approver for the fix and review the test coverage.
lee: for the recurring slow-query pattern, can we link the historical incidents so we can see cadence? I can help compile them.
elaine: yes — please add links as comments in the ticket. also create an epic if it looks like a multi-release mitigation.
omar: created ticket TCK-8120 and linked 3 prior incidents. added labels `remediation` and `recurring-pattern`.
pm-bot: TCK-8120 created and assigned to omar. reminder set for 2026-03-27T18:00:00Z.
taylor: another item: increase runbook coverage for Canary rollbacks. propose R: lee, A: elaine.
lee: will draft the rollback steps and short verification checklist. targeting Mon morning.
elaine: process ask: let's standardize on R/A single owners and include a 2-line acceptance criteria field in Jira to close the loop.
omar: +1. I'll add acceptance criteria to TCK-8120: reproduce case, metric added, smoke test, and canary pass.
taylor: also opened an epic TCK-8200 "recurring-performance-mitigations" and linked TCK-8120. please add other tickets as children.
lee: uploaded a short query latency histogram to the ticket: https://grafana.internal/d/patterns (WIP). feedback welcome.
elaine: thanks everyone. we'll do a 10m check-in next Wed 09:15 UTC to confirm progress. marking thread as follow-up in progress. :thumbsup:
